title: Novel phenothiazine-based sensitizers for high-performance dye-sensitized solar cells: enhanced photovoltaic properties through strategic Co-sensitization with N719
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13896-13907
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00694E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sara H. Yousef, Ehab Abdel-Latif, Safa A. Badawy, Mohamed R. Elmorsy
This study presents a systematic investigation of novel phenothiazine-based sensitizers (SR1–6) for dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs), both as individual sensitizers and in co-sensitization with ruthenium-based N-719 dye.
